_note: Channels the collector reads, archives first (owner, 18 Nov 2026; docs/SUPPLY-CHECK.md). kind: ARCHIVE (festival or broadcaster archive: official, read first), ARTIST (a band's official channel), MIXED (official, several kinds of music: a label, a broadcaster). The collector reads ARCHIVE entries first, then ARTIST, then MIXED, keeping this file's order within each kind. handle is tried first (1 unit); otherwise the collector searches YouTube for 'search' (100 units, once: the result is stored) and takes the first channel whose name contains 'expect' (accents and punctuation ignored). skipIds: channels never to use. Handles are left out until checked against the live channel.
_artistChannels: Official channels of bands in the catalogue are added automatically by the refresh job (kind ARTIST).

discovery._note: A few YouTube searches per run (100 units each), rotating through catalogue bands. Results from fan channels are reported, never published.
